title: Wander
description: A lone figure in a tan trench coat stands on a cracked road in a post-apocalyptic landscape, back turned to the viewer. The person carries a film reel case and reaches toward a chain-link fence lined with film strips and a shopping cart, surrounded by ruins, old movie equipment, and a large decaying sign reading 'WANDER' under an aurora borealis sky.
prompt: A solitary person wearing a long tan trench coat stands on a broken highway in a ruined cinematic landscape, back to viewer, carrying a film reel case while reaching toward a fence with film strips and a shopping cart filled with reels. Decaying buildings, old movie cameras and film equipment scattered on the ground, large broken sign that reads WANDER in the distance, dramatic purple and teal aurora borealis sky, desolate and melancholic atmosphere.
